## Whole Orchard Recycling - Space for time 2023

This space for time substitution experiment was conducted in four experimental almond orchards that have whole orchard recycling (WOR) and control treatments. These 4 fields were each sampled in 4 replicate blocks per treatment in Summer 2023 at the University of California Kearney Agricultural Research and Extension Center (UC KARE) located in Fresno County, CA. The soils were first seived to <2 mm and then separated into POM and MAOM fractions. All POM and MAOM samples were air-dried, diluted to 10% (w/w) with pre-ground potassium bromide (KBr), and then analyzed by DRIFTS spectroscopy. Spectral subtractions were performed in OMNIC, to remove the absorbance of inorganic covalent bonds such as Si-O (which compose the mineral contribution of soil).

Space for Time Substitution Design (Fields + Years):
Field K32 (est. 2008) 15 yrs  |   67 Mg wood chips per ha   | Blocks 2,3,4,6
Field K74 (est. 2017)  6 yrs  |   191 Mg wood chips per ha  | Blocks 11,12,13,14
Field K92 (est. 2019)  4 yrs  |   134 Mg wood chips per ha  | Blocks 1,2,3,5
Field K95 (est. 2020)  3 yrs  |   110 Mg wood chips per ha  | Blocks 1,2,3,4

POM and MAOM Sample (#) shorthand key:
   [K92]         [K31]        [K74]          [K95]
1. B1 - CN    9.  B2 - CN   17. B11 - CN    25. B1 - CN
2. B2 - CN    10. B3 - CN   18. B12 - CN    26. B2 - CN
3. B3 - CN    11. B4 - CN   19. B13 - CN    27. B3 - CN
4. B5 - CN    12. B6 - CN   20. B14 - CN    28. B4 - CN
5. B1 - WC    13. B2 - WC   21. B11 - WC    29. B1 - WC
6. B2 - WC    14. B3 - WC   22. B12 - WC    30. B2 - WC
7. B3 - WC    15. B4 - WC   23. B13 - WC    31. B3 - WC
8. B5 - WC    16. B6 - WC   24. B14 - WC    32. B4 - WC 
Note: CN = Control, WC = Wood Chip treatments

## Load Libraries and Import the metadata
```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Load Packages
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)   # Provides p-values for lmer models
library(ggplot2)
library(car)
library(DescTools)  
library(rcompanion) # For plotNormalHistogram
library(emmeans)
library(dplyr) # used to filter

# Load the Metadata and Subtraction Index Values
SFT_meta <- readRDS(file = "WOR_SFT_2023_Metadata.rds")

# Adjust the class of experimental variables
str(SFT_meta) # Need to convert Treatment, Field, Block, and Year to factors
SFT_meta$Treatment <- as.factor(SFT_meta$Treatment)
SFT_meta$Field <- as.factor(SFT_meta$Field)
SFT_meta$Year_of_WOR <- as.factor(SFT_meta$Year_of_WOR)
SFT_meta$Block_ID <- as.factor(SFT_meta$Block_ID)
```
The SFT_meta dataframe includes is for 32 soil samples (4 fields * 2 treatments * 4 blocks) that were sieved to <2 mm prior to collection of the following data:

TC - Total C [of the <2 mm soil] (%)
TN - Total N [of the <2 mm soil] (%)
C:N - CN_Ratio (TC % / TN %)
EOC - Extractable Organic Carbon (mg C / g soil ODW)
ExtN - Extractable Organic Nitrogen (mg N / g soil ODW)
POM TC - Total C [of the POM fraction] (%)
POM TN - Total N [of the POM fraction] (%)
MAOM TC - Total C [of the MAOM fraction] (%)
MAOM TN - Total N [of the MAOM fraction] (%)
POM C:N - POM_CN_Ratio (POM TC % / POM TN %)
MAOM C:N - MAOM_CN_Ratio (MAOM TC % / MAOM TN %)
POM Aliphatic C : Aromatic C (Index value 1)
POM Aromatic C : Carboxylic C (Index value 2)
MAOM Aliphatic C : Aromatic C (Index value 1)
MAOM Aromatic C : Carboxylic C (Index value 2)

## Mixed Models - Two-way ANOVAs with lm

# Total Carbon
```{r}
# Fit the model
TC_model <- lm(TC ~ Treatment * Field, data = SFT_meta)

# Perform the ANOVA
TC_results <- anova(TC_model)

# Display the ANOVA results
print(TC_results) # Year_of_WOR:Treatment is significant !

# Check residuals of the lm model
plot(TC_model)
qqnorm(residuals(TC_model))
plotNormalHistogram(residuals(TC_model))
shapiro.test(residuals(TC_model))
# W = 0.94406, p-value = 0.09766

# ----------------------------
# TRANSFORMATIONS
# ----------------------------
# Tested Log10, Square-root, Inverse, Cube-root transformations
# Cube-root transformation worked best
SFT_meta$cbrt_TC <- SFT_meta$TC^(1/3)
cbrt_TC_lm <- lm(cbrt_TC ~ Treatment * Field, data = SFT_meta)
shapiro.test(residuals(cbrt_TC_lm)) # looks best, and highest p-value
# W = 0.98767, p-value = 0.9675
qqnorm(residuals(cbrt_TC_lm))
plotNormalHistogram(residuals(cbrt_TC_lm))

# ------------------------------------
# TC ANOVA
# ------------------------------------
anova(cbrt_TC_lm)
#Response: cbrt_TC
#                Df   Sum Sq  Mean Sq F value    Pr(>F)    
#Treatment        1 0.146201 0.146201 37.0831 2.735e-06 ***
#Field            3 0.065780 0.021927  5.5616 0.0048241 ** 
#Treatment:Field  3 0.098853 0.032951  8.3579 0.0005585 ***
#Residuals       24 0.094620 0.003943 

# ----------------------
# POST-HOC PAIRWISE COMPARISONS
# ----------------------
# Compare treatments within each field
TC_Treatment_PH <- emmeans(cbrt_TC_lm, ~ Treatment | Field)
pairwise_contrasts_TC <- contrast(TC_Treatment_PH,  method = "pairwise", adjust = "bonferroni")

summary(pairwise_contrasts_TC)
plot(TC_Treatment_PH)

#Field = K31:
# contrast estimate     SE df t.ratio p.value
# CN - WC    0.0185 0.0444 24   0.418  0.6800

#Field = K74:
# contrast estimate     SE df t.ratio p.value
# CN - WC   -0.2198 0.0444 24  -4.951  <.0001 *

#Field = K92:
# contrast estimate     SE df t.ratio p.value
# CN - WC   -0.2599 0.0444 24  -5.853  <.0001 *

#Field = K95:
# contrast estimate     SE df t.ratio p.value
# CN - WC   -0.0796 0.0444 24  -1.793  0.0856

TC_Field_PH <- emmeans(cbrt_TC_lm, ~ Field | Treatment)
pairwise_contrasts_TC <- contrast(TC_Field_PH,  method = "pairwise", adjust = "bonferroni")
summary(pairwise_contrasts_TC)
plot(TC_Field_PH)

#Treatment = CN:
# contrast  estimate     SE df t.ratio p.value
# K31 - K74  0.06702 0.0444 24   1.510  0.8652
# K31 - K92  0.12513 0.0444 24   2.818  0.0571 .
# K31 - K95  0.12199 0.0444 24   2.748  0.0673
# K74 - K92  0.05811 0.0444 24   1.309  1.0000
# K74 - K95  0.05496 0.0444 24   1.238  1.0000
# K92 - K95 -0.00315 0.0444 24  -0.071  1.0000

#Treatment = WC:
# contrast  estimate     SE df t.ratio p.value
# K31 - K74 -0.17132 0.0444 24  -3.859  0.0045 *
# K31 - K92 -0.15328 0.0444 24  -3.452  0.0124 *
# K31 - K95  0.02384 0.0444 24   0.537  1.0000
# K74 - K92  0.01804 0.0444 24   0.406  1.0000
# K74 - K95  0.19516 0.0444 24   4.396  0.0012 *
# K92 - K95  0.17712 0.0444 24   3.989  0.0032 *
```

# Total Nitrogen
```{r}
# Fit the model
```

# C:N Ratio
```{r}
# Fit the model
CN_model <- lm(CN_Ratio ~ Treatment * Field, data = SFT_meta)

# Perform the ANOVA
CN_results <- anova(CN_model)

# Display the ANOVA results
print(CN_results) # Year_of_WOR:Treatment is NOT significant

# Check residuals of the lm model
plot(CN_model)
qqnorm(residuals(CN_model))
plotNormalHistogram(residuals(CN_model))
shapiro.test(residuals(CN_model))
# W = 0.97251, p-value = 0.5715

# ----------------------------
# TRANSFORMATIONS
# ----------------------------
# Tested Log10, Square-root, Inverse, Cube-root transformations
# Untransformed data worked best

# ------------------------------------
# C:N Ratio ANOVA
# ------------------------------------
anova(CN_model)
#Response: CN_Ratio
#                Df Sum Sq Mean Sq F value    Pr(>F)    
#Treatment        1 11.513 11.5134 10.4682  0.003524 ** 
#Field            3 46.325 15.4417 14.0399 1.718e-05 ***
#Treatment:Field  3  5.171  1.7237  1.5672  0.223236    
#Residuals       24 26.396  1.0998  

# ----------------------
# POST-HOC PAIRWISE COMPARISONS
# ----------------------
# There arte only 2 levels of treatment, so we do not perform the post-hoc for WOR vs Control.
# Post hoc of Field
CN_Field_PH <- emmeans(CN_model, ~ Field)
pairwise_contrasts_CN <- contrast(CN_Field_PH, method = "pairwise", adjust = "bonferroni")
summary(pairwise_contrasts_CN)
plot(CN_Field_PH)

# contrast  estimate    SE df t.ratio p.value
# K31 - K74   -1.899 0.524 24  -3.621  0.0082 *
# K31 - K92    0.751 0.524 24   1.431  0.9912
# K31 - K95    1.275 0.524 24   2.432  0.1372
# K74 - K92    2.649 0.524 24   5.053  0.0002 ***
# K74 - K95    3.174 0.524 24   6.053 <0.0001 ***
# K92 - K95    0.525 0.524 24   1.000  1.0000
```

# POM Total Carbon
```{r}
# Fit the model
```

# MAOM Total Nitrogen
```{r}
# Fit the model with main effects and interaction
MAOM_TN_model <- lm(MAOM_TN ~ Treatment * Field, data = SFT_meta)

# Perform the ANOVA
MAOM_TN_results <- anova(MAOM_TN_model)

# Display the ANOVA results
print(MAOM_TN_results) # Year_of_WOR:Treatment not significant !
```

## Helix 2026 Indices, Revised for Wood (aromatic hydrocarbon) Amendment
# Spectral Index Values for Aliphatic C : Aromatic C (1) and Aromatic C : Carboxylic C (2) Index Values

# Index 1 (Aliphatic : Aromatic) and 2 (Aromatic : Carboxylic),
In accordance with the wavenumber corresponding to the 13 organic bands described in Margenot et al 2015: https://acsess.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.2136/sssaj2015.02.0070

Index 1 = (2931 + 2871) / (1660 + 1600 + 1540 + 1510)
# ( Aliphatic : Aromatic )

Index 2 = (1660 + 1600 + 1540 + 1510) / (1724 + 1320 + 1275)
# ( Aromatic : Carboxylic )

# Note:
Sample POM 4 (K92_B5_CN) needs to be removed before the following model fitting can be performed. Essentially, the spectral subtraction for this sample yielded negative peaks, and the resulting Index values are sometimes "Inf", NA, or 0.000. This samples is clearly an outlier, and is impeding ANOVA due to the following error:

anova_model_main <- lm(POM_Aliphatic_Aromatic ~ Field + Treatment, data = SFT_meta)
Error in lm.fit(x, y, offset = offset, singular.ok = singular.ok, ...) : 
  NA/NaN/Inf in 'y'

Due to the structure of the data table (Sample ID as rows, with POM and MAOM values as columns), the simplest solution is to create a copy of the metadata, with the problematic POM sample removed:
```{r}
# Create a filtered dataset only for POM analysis
SFT_meta_POM <- SFT_meta %>%
  filter(Sample != "K92_B5_CN")  # exclude bad sample
```

# POM Index 1 (Aliphatic : Aromatic) Helix (outliers filtered)
```{r}
# POM Aliphatic : Aromatic
# ------------------------------------
# Outlier removal (IQR) for POM Aliphatic : Aromatic Index
# ------------------------------------
remove_outliers <- function(x) {
  Q1 <- quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  Q3 <- quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  IQR <- Q3 - Q1
  x[x < (Q1 - 1.5 * IQR) | x > (Q3 + 1.5 * IQR)] <- NA
  return(x)
}
SFT_meta_POM$POM_Aliphatic_Aromatic_filtered <- remove_outliers(SFT_meta_POM$POM_Aliphatic_Aromatic)

# Fit the model
POM_1_model <- lm(POM_Aliphatic_Aromatic_filtered ~ Treatment * Field, data = SFT_meta_POM)
POM_1_results <- anova(POM_1_model)
print(POM_1_results) # Year_of_WOR:Treatment is significant!

# Residual diagnostics
plot(POM_1_model)
qqnorm(residuals(POM_1_model))
plotNormalHistogram(residuals(POM_1_model))
shapiro.test(residuals(POM_1_model))
# W = 0.95636, p-value = 0.2666

# ----------------------------
# TRANSFORMATIONS
# ----------------------------
# Tested Log10, Square-root, Inverse, Cube-root transformations
# Cube-root transformation worked best
SFT_meta_POM$cbrt_POM_Aliphatic_Aromatic <- SFT_meta_POM$POM_Aliphatic_Aromatic_filtered^(1/3)
cbrt_POM_Aliphatic_Aromatic_lm <- lm(cbrt_POM_Aliphatic_Aromatic ~ Treatment * Field, data = SFT_meta_POM)
shapiro.test(residuals(cbrt_POM_Aliphatic_Aromatic_lm))
# W = 0.98392, p-value = 0.9246
qqnorm(residuals(cbrt_POM_Aliphatic_Aromatic_lm))
plotNormalHistogram(residuals(cbrt_POM_Aliphatic_Aromatic_lm))

# ------------------------------------
# POM index 1 ANOVA (Aliphatic : Aromatic)
# ------------------------------------
anova(cbrt_POM_Aliphatic_Aromatic_lm)
#Response: cbrt_POM_Aliphatic_Aromatic
#                Df  Sum Sq  Mean Sq F value    Pr(>F)    
#Treatment        1 0.01886 0.018864  1.0552 0.3160013    
#Field            3 0.60464 0.201548 11.2741 0.0001285 ***
#Treatment:Field  3 0.18632 0.062107  3.4741 0.0342667 *  
#Residuals       21 0.37542 0.017877                      

POM_Aliphatic_Aromatic_Treatment_PH <- emmeans(cbrt_POM_Aliphatic_Aromatic_lm, ~ Treatment | Field)
pairwise_contrasts_POM_Aliphatic_Aromatic <- contrast(POM_Aliphatic_Aromatic_Treatment_PH, method = "pairwise", adjust = "bonferroni")
summary(pairwise_contrasts_POM_Aliphatic_Aromatic)
plot(POM_Aliphatic_Aromatic_Treatment_PH)

#Field = K31:
# contrast estimate     SE df t.ratio p.value
# CN - WC  -0.02968 0.0945 21  -0.314  0.7567

#Field = K74:
# contrast estimate     SE df t.ratio p.value
# CN - WC   0.19905 0.1020 21   1.949  0.0648

#Field = K92:
# contrast estimate     SE df t.ratio p.value
# CN - WC  -0.29868 0.1160 21  -2.579  0.0175 *

#Field = K95:
# contrast estimate     SE df t.ratio p.value
# CN - WC  -0.00678 0.0945 21  -0.072  0.9435

# Extract significant post-hoc contrasts – Treatment within Field
pom_index1_Tsig <- as.data.frame(summary(pairwise_contrasts_POM_Aliphatic_Aromatic)) %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(Parameter = "POM_Aliphatic_Aromatic")

POM_Aliphatic_Aromatic_Field_PH <- emmeans(cbrt_POM_Aliphatic_Aromatic_lm, ~ Field | Treatment)
pairwise_contrasts_POM_Aliphatic_Aromatic <- contrast(POM_Aliphatic_Aromatic_Field_PH, method = "pairwise", adjust = "bonferroni")
summary(pairwise_contrasts_POM_Aliphatic_Aromatic)
plot(POM_Aliphatic_Aromatic_Field_PH)

#Treatment = CN:
```

# MAOM Index 1 (Decomposition) Helix (outliers filtered)

```{r}
# MAOM Decomposition
# ------------------------------------
# Outlier removal (IQR) for MAOM Decomposition Index
# ------------------------------------
remove_outliers <- function(x) {
  Q1 <- quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  Q3 <- quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  IQR <- Q3 - Q1
  x[x < (Q1 - 1.5 * IQR) | x > (Q3 + 1.5 * IQR)] <- NA
  return(x)
}
SFT_meta$MAOM_Aliphatic_Aromatic_filtered <- remove_outliers(SFT_meta$MAOM_Aliphatic_Aromatic)

# Fit the model
MAOM_1_model <- lm(MAOM_Aliphatic_Aromatic_filtered ~ Treatment * Field, data = SFT_meta)
MAOM_1_results <- anova(MAOM_1_model)
print(MAOM_1_results) # Year_of_WOR:Treatment is significant!

# Check residuals of the lm model
plot(MAOM_1_model)
qqnorm(residuals(MAOM_1_model))
plotNormalHistogram(residuals(MAOM_1_model))
shapiro.test(residuals(MAOM_1_model))
```

# MAOM Index 2 (Recalcitrance) Helix (outliers filtered)
# ( Aromatic : Carboxylic ) Index
```{r}
# MAOM Recalcitrance
# ------------------------------------
# Outlier removal (IQR) for MAOM Recalcitrance Index
# ------------------------------------
remove_outliers <- function(x) {
  Q1 <- quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  Q3 <- quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  IQR <- Q3 - Q1
  x[x < (Q1 - 1.5 * IQR) | x > (Q3 + 1.5 * IQR)] <- NA
  return(x)
}
SFT_meta$MAOM_Aromatic_Carboxylic_filtered <- remove_outliers(SFT_meta$MAOM_Aromatic_Carboxylic)

# Fit the model
MAOM_2_model <- lm(MAOM_Aromatic_Carboxylic_filtered ~ Field * Treatment, data = SFT_meta)
MAOM_2_results <- anova(MAOM_2_model)
print(MAOM_2_results)

# Check residuals of the lm model
plot(MAOM_2_model)
qqnorm(residuals(MAOM_2_model))
plotNormalHistogram(residuals(MAOM_2_model))
shapiro.test(residuals(MAOM_2_model))
# W = 0.98297, p-value = 0.8889

# ----------------------------
# TRANSFORMATIONS
# ----------------------------
# Tested Log10, Square-root, Inverse, Cube-root transformations
# Square-root transformation worked best
SFT_meta$sqrt_MAOM_Aromatic_Carboxylic <- sqrt(SFT_meta$MAOM_Aromatic_Carboxylic_filtered)
sqrt_MAOM_Aromatic_Carboxylic_lm <- lm(sqrt_MAOM_Aromatic_Carboxylic ~ Treatment * Field, data = SFT_meta)
shapiro.test(residuals(sqrt_MAOM_Aromatic_Carboxylic_lm))
# W = 0.98405, p-value = 0.9127
qqnorm(residuals(sqrt_MAOM_Aromatic_Carboxylic_lm))
plotNormalHistogram(residuals(sqrt_MAOM_Aromatic_Carboxylic_lm))

# ------------------------------------
# MAOM index 2 ANOVA ( Aromatic : Carboxylic )
# ------------------------------------
anova(sqrt_MAOM_Aromatic_Carboxylic_lm)
#Response: sqrt_MAOM_Aromatic_Carboxylic
#                Df   Sum Sq   Mean Sq F value   Pr(>F)   
#Treatment        1 0.006591 0.0065915  1.8840 0.183117   
#Field            3 0.064110 0.0213701  6.1081 0.003265 **
#Treatment:Field  3 0.021227 0.0070756  2.0224 0.138799   
#Residuals       23 0.080469 0.0034986

# Post-hoc of Field
MAOM_Aromatic_Carboxylic_Field_PH <- emmeans(sqrt_MAOM_Aromatic_Carboxylic_lm, ~ Field)
pairwise_contrasts_MAOM_Aromatic_Carboxylic <- contrast(MAOM_Aromatic_Carboxylic_Field_PH, method = "pairwise", adjust = "bonferroni")
summary(pairwise_contrasts_MAOM_Aromatic_Carboxylic)
plot(MAOM_Aromatic_Carboxylic_Field_PH)

# contrast  estimate     SE df t.ratio p.value
# K31 - K74   0.0303 0.0308 23   0.985  1.0000
# K31 - K92  -0.0421 0.0296 23  -1.424  1.0000
# K31 - K95   0.0806 0.0296 23   2.726  0.0723
# K74 - K92  -0.0724 0.0308 23  -2.353  0.1652
# K74 - K95   0.0503 0.0308 23   1.634  0.6953
# K92 - K95   0.1227 0.0296 23   4.150  0.0023

# Collect significant post-hocs
maom_index2_Fsig <- as.data.frame(summary(contrast(MAOM_Aromatic_Carboxylic_Field_PH, method = "pairwise", adjust = "bonferroni"))) %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(Parameter = "MAOM_Aromatic_Carboxylic")
```
